让我们来看看寒冰系的新功能：冻结值: Let's take a look at the mechanics of the Cryo System: Cryo Points
寒冰类植物的攻击都会附带冻结值\n当冻结值满时僵尸会被冻结并清空冻结值，冻结的僵:
Ice-type plants' attacks will add Cryo Points to the Cryo Value. 
When the Cryo Value is full, zombies will be inflicted with the Frozen debuff and the Cryo Value will be reset. 
Frozen zombies will take x4 damage from ice-type projectiles.
僵尸的冻结值上限会随着冻结次数的增加而增加:
The Cryo Value threshold of zombies will increase with each Frozen debuff inflicted.
 The first threshold is 100 Cryo Points, the next will be 200, then 300, then 400.
 The max threshold is 400 Cryo Points.

Kelps deal additional percentage damage to zombies in the water.
Hitting more than 30 times will instantly kill the zombie!
让我们来看看僵尸的一种新状态：红温: Let's take a look at the mechanics of a new zombie debuff: Enflamed.
当僵尸处于红温状态时会额外受到50%的伤害: When a zombie is inflicted with the Enflamed debuff, it will take an additional 50% damage.
红温的僵尸死亡时会对附近的僵尸造成100点伤害并传递红温效果: When an Enflamed zombie dies, it will deal 100 damage to nearby zombies and spread the Enflamed debuff.
路灯花在这里发挥着比原版更强大的作用: The Plantern plays a more powerful role here than in the original version.
让我们来看看路灯花的新系统：光照系统: Let's take a look at the new system for the Plantern: the Lumos System.
路灯花会以自己为中心3x3范围的格子提供1点光照等级: The Plantern provides 1 Lumos Level in a 3x3 area centered around itself.
路灯花的融合植物在路灯花的影响下会变得更加强大: Plantern fusions become even stronger under its influence.
光照越高，植物就越强，一般的光系植物在3点光照等级达到最强状态: The higher the Lumos Level, the stronger the plant. Most light-based plants reach their maximum strength at 3 Lumos Levels.

Plantern-based fusions become even stronger under the influence of the Plantern.
Interesting things happen to Sun-shrooms when they're under Lumos influence, too!
让我们来看看磁力菇带来的新系统\n磁力系统: The Magnetic System is a new system centered around Magnet-shroom fusions.
如果一株磁性植物周围8格有另一株磁性植物\n则称两个植物处于同一个磁力系统中，并:
If a magnetic plant has another magnetic plant within the 8 surrounding tiles, 
they are considered to be in the same magnetic system, and a white line will connect them.
同一个磁力系统中的植物是可以无限多的\n只需任意一株植物满足要求都可以纳入系统中:
Plants within the same magnetic system can be unlimited in number. 
As long as any plant meets the requirements, it can be included in the system.
只要磁力链没有断开，都看成在是同一个磁力系统中: As long as the magnetic chain remains unbroken, all plants are considered to be in the same magnetic system.
但是如果没有相连，那就是另一个磁力系统: However, if they are not connected, they belong to a different magnetic system.
你可以在中间补充一些植物将两个系统连起来:
You can place plants in between to connect the two systems.
A select few plants are buffed by the system, check the almanac for details!

P.S.: Solar Magnet generates metal objects that can be used to feed
Morph-plants (the blue and gray Magnet-shroom fusions) to create more metal fusions!
让我们来看看金盏花带来的新系统\n金钱系统: Let's take a look at the new system brought by Marigold: the Money System.
种植金盏花会在屏幕左下角启用钱币: Planting Marigolds will activate coins in the bottom-left corner of the screen.

Click on the coffee bean (or use the hotkey) in the bottom-left corner of the screen to use it on the Cabbage-Pult.

When upgrading, plants will unleash an ultimate, and Golden Plants can also unleash their ultimate.
Additionally, every time you spend money, you will receive Sun as a bonus!
Each 500 coins spent will give 25 Suns.

it will trigger the ultimates of other plants on nearby Golden Pots based on the cost.

<size=3><color=#720026>Enflamed</color>
Zombies take 50% more damage, and upon death, they explode, dealing 100 damage to nearby zombies and spreading the Enflamed debuff. Incompatible with Poisoned and Chill. Irradiated adds another 10% to the extra damage.

<color=#0077b6>Chill</color>
Chilled zombies are slowed by a factor of 50%. Zombies start with a Cryo Points cap of 100. When the accumulated Cryo Points reaches the cap, the zombie will be frozen for 4s, then the cap increases by 100, up to a maximum of 1000. Irradiated adds another 10% to the slow factor.

<color=#006400>Tangled</color>
Each time Tangled is applied, it deals extra max HP percentage damage based on the zombie's current Tangle Value:
6~10: 1%, 11~15: 3%, 16~29: 5%, 30+: 100%

<color=#5E1675>Poison</color>
A zombie's Poison Value cap is 5. When it reaches 5, any further accumulation will put the zombie in a poisoned state, losing HP every second equal to 20×(Poison Value). If the Poison Value is at 5 and the zombie is hit by a Garlic Butter projectile, this cap will increase to 30. Irradiated makes Poison lasts indefinitely.

<color=yellow>Lumos Level</color>
Planterns provide 1 Lumos Level to all tiles in a 3×3 area. There is no cap on a tile's Lumos Level.

<color=#666699>Magnetic System</color>
When a magnetic plant is within a 3×3 range of another magnetic plant, they are considered to be in the same Magnetic System.

2. You can only buy Modifiers from the Shop, which is available after every round. You gain a set amount of points every round and the amount is not affected by the number of zombies defeated.
3. Select Investment Modifiers at the start of the second round of each map. Higher tiered Investment Modifiers increase Base Difficulty.
4. Base Difficulty affects Affinity base damage, zombie HP, and zombie damage reduction.
5. Modifiers bought from the Shop can form Affinitys, which grant powerful effects. See View Modifiers - Modifier Bonuses for detailed Affinity effects.
6. Affinity Unlock rules: Unlocking any one Modifier of a plant unlocks that plant's Affinity. Unlocking two Modifiers unlocks its subspecies' Affinity (if applicable).
7. For Affinities, 100% Base Damage = 10000 × Current Round × 1.05^(Base Difficulty).

<color=red>红温</color>\n效果：僵尸受到的伤害增加50%，且:
<size=3><color=#720026>Enflamed</color>
Zombies take 50% more damage, and upon death, they explode, dealing 100 damage to nearby zombies and spreading the Enflamed debuff. Incompatible with Poisoned and Chill. Irradiated adds another 10% to the extra damage.

<color=#0077b6>Chill</color>
Chilled zombies are slowed by a factor of 50%. Zombies start with a Cryo Points cap of 100. When the accumulated Cryo Points reaches the cap, the zombie will be frozen for 4s, then the cap increases by 100, up to a maximum of 1000. Irradiated adds another 10% to the slow factor.

<color=#006400>Tangled</color>
Each time Tangled is applied, it deals extra max HP percentage damage based on the zombie's current Tangle Value:
6~10: 1%, 11~15: 3%, 16~29: 5%, 30+: 100%

<color=#5E1675>Poison</color>
A zombie's Poison Value cap is 5. When it reaches 5, any further accumulation will put the zombie in a poisoned state, losing HP every second equal to 20×(Poison Value). If the Poison Value is at 5 and the zombie is hit by a Garlic Butter projectile, this cap will increase to 30. Irradiated makes Poison lasts indefinitely.

<color=yellow>Lumos Level</color>
Planterns provide 1 Lumos Level to all tiles in a 3×3 area. There is no cap on a tile's Lumos Level.

<color=#666699>Magnetic System</color>
When a magnetic plant is within a 3×3 range of another magnetic plant, they are considered to be in the same Magnetic System.
